lessons.observation: AETHER OS ran as a single Grok session plus human issue claims. Gemini had no join path.
lessons.change: Add Grok-led team protocol, run directory, GEMINI.md handoff, and a required RSI lesson on every run.

lessons.observation: Gemini offered three exclusive collaboration options (flywheel, ask-grok API, async handoff). Picking one would have dropped the OS default we just shipped.
lessons.change: Treat the three options as stacked layers. Encode that in GEMINI.md, protocol.md, and the team skill. Ship the flywheel as the first joint slice, PR-only, cron off until secrets exist.

lessons.observation: Gemini's flywheel draft lived at github:workflows:nephelis-flywheel.yml (not a GitHub Actions path), threw at import without API keys, used git add -A, and omitted preview/archive/user-src from the write ban.
lessons.change: Place the workflow at .github/workflows/nephelis-flywheel.yml. Lazy-init clients. --self-check needs no keys. Add only written files. Expand forbidden prefixes. No git clean -fd.

lessons.observation: npx tsx automation/scripts/flywheel-sync.ts --self-check from repo root hits the npm registry. tsx already lives under automation/node_modules.
lessons.change: Document pnpm --dir automation self-check (and typecheck) as the offline-safe commands.
